notes.title: qrth phyl soundtrack
notes.notes:
I've (finally) released the qrth-phyl soundtrack on bandcamp:
https://verran.bandcamp.com/

Its a mix of old and new tracks from the game, the qrth trailers and noodling with the ZX Spectrum+ the audio was all sourced from. It's free/pay-what-you-want. Might add it to steam soundtracks if anyone is interested?

Don't forget the, still excellent, new soundtrack by Rolando Simmons that came out when qrth-phyl was first put up on steam:
https://rolandosimmons.bandcamp.com/album/qrth-phyl

notes.title: 3D Snake em up qrth-phyl returns with new modes
notes.notes: What goes around comes back stronger, and goodness me it’s nice to have qrth-phyl come back. Last seen by us in 2012, the arcade Snake-o-dotgobbler from the glowing mind behind Leave Home has returned to us through a Steam release with new modes and online leaderboards. I have bought it, downloaded it, loaded it, burnt a few lives, then closed it because mate this is a bit much for me in the dying hours of my working week. Still pleasant, still colourful, still getting mighty tricky as your snake grows longer and longer coiling over and inside 3D objects. (more…)

notes.title: QRTH-PHYL is released
notes.notes:
After spending the last few days cramming in a load of new tweaks and improvements I compiled the a build minutes before release time. Drank one cup of tea. Clicked the release button. QRTH-PHYL is available to buy on Steam. It's the best version of the game I think, and I'm planning on adding a few more things in the next few weeks.

Thanks to anyone buying or helping promote the game.

Also now available, the excellent QRTH-PHYL NEW SOUNDTRACK by Rolando Simmons, get it here via bandcamp: https://rolandosimmons.bandcamp.com/album/qrth-phyl

cheers
Matt V
